base-post-story-cleanup.rule: All base chests and emblems remain obtainable after the story; this does not claim every chest is available on the first visit.

sandbar-hidden-lagoon.directions: Opposite Sandbar Isle’s save point, climb the pillars behind three trees with Doubleflight. Drop into the enclosed lagoon; the left underwater cave contains chests 31–32, the right contains 33–40.

sourceCautions: PowerPyx Twilight Town introduction incorrectly repeats Olympus counts; numbered body contains the correct ten chests and nine emblems.
Guide area headings are route groupings, not authoritative replacement names for canonical areas.
Normalization preserves Petit/Petite, Bandana/Bandanna, Horseshoe Isle/Island and Trail/Trial aliases; spelling corrections are not edition substitutions.
All 335 numbered paragraphs were reviewed against the current record. Retained landmark hints are not rewritten copies of the guide and are not all save-point-to-pickup narratives.

residuals.reason: Complete guides describe cleanup navigation and selected movement actions, not a per-row proof of the earliest possible story flag or every alternative mobility route.
GamerGuides: world revisit required; PowerPyx: revisit easier. Both establish the same post-clear pickup approach.
